name: At Home in the Shadows
summary: Rorian sends you to meet Akeri Duskblade in Thendal Grove, where rogue training begins. The summons marks a change from village chores to stealth and combat.

sections.title: A Shady Invitation
sections.body: Akeri Duskblade has noticed young rogues dealing with threats around Thendal Grove. The grove's rogue trainer avoids an open meeting in the settlement, so he sends a note through Rorian the Dayseeker. Though Akeri keeps his reasons close, Rorian sees that he knows the skills a rogue needs beyond the grove's sheltered bounds.

sections.title: Lessons in the Watchtower
sections.body: Akeri Duskblade waits in the Thendal Grove village watchtower. He judges each newcomer’s footing and awareness, then warns that careless steps beyond the grove can lead to an early grave. Passing his scrutiny begins formal training in stealth, precision, and survival on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Who gives the quest At Home in the Shadows?
aliases: who starts at home in the shadows
quest giver at home in the shadows
faq.answer: Rorian the Dayseeker gives you Akeri's summons in thendal grove on zephras isle after you complete Harmony in Balance.

faq.q: Where can I find Akeri Duskblade?
faq.answer: Akeri Duskblade waits inside the village watchtower in thendal grove on zephras isle.

faq.q: What is the Simple Note given during the quest?
faq.answer: Akeri Duskblade's Simple Note asks promising rogues to meet him. Read it before you speak with Akeri.

faq.q: Is this quest available to all classes?
aliases: can non rogues do this quest
is at home in the shadows rogue only
faq.answer: No. The training is for rogues learning their trade in Thendal Grove.
Akeri Duskblade teaches local rogues in Thendal Grove stealth, cunning, and bladecraft as they begin their journey across Zephras Isle.

faq.q: What prerequisite quest must be completed first?
aliases: at home in the shadows prerequisite
unlock at home in the shadows
faq.answer: Complete Harmony in Balance for Rorian the Dayseeker first. Then he gives you Akeri's note.

angles.text: As a rogue, you begin formal training on Zephras Isle when you meet Akeri Duskblade in the Thendal Grove watchtower.
